title: Implement parseDuration()
prompt: src/duration.js exports parseDuration(input) but it is a stub. Parse strings made of one or more <integer><unit> parts with units d, h, m, s, ms (for example '1h30m', '45s', '500ms', '1d2h3m4s') and return the total in milliseconds. Throw a RangeError for an empty string, a non-string, or anything that is not exactly a sequence of valid parts (including strings with spaces).
acceptance: parseDuration() sums <integer><unit> parts for units d, h, m, s, ms in milliseconds [tests: seconds, hours and minutes, days, all units, milliseconds are not minutes]
throws RangeError for empty strings and non-strings [tests: empty string throws, non-string throws]
throws RangeError for anything that is not exactly a sequence of valid parts, including spaces [tests: garbage throws, unknown unit throws, spaces throw]
